codeReview.summary: Clean, well-targeted fix for the Celsius temperature confirmation bug. The implementation correctly multiplies set_temp back by the temp_divisor (2.0 for Celsius, 1.0 for Fahrenheit) before casting to u8 and comparing against the raw wire value. This is the inverse of the decode operation in StatusUpdate::parse() where set_temp = payload[20] as f32 / temp_divisor. Five new tests cover all five validation assertions: Fahrenheit confirmation (VAL-CORE-001), Celsius even raw (VAL-CORE-002), Celsius odd raw (VAL-CORE-003), Celsius boundary odd (VAL-CORE-004), and mismatch retry for both scales (VAL-CORE-005). All 27 launa-core tests pass. Worker followed TDD methodology per transcript.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The architecture.md already documents that CommandTracker handles both Fahrenheit and Celsius temperature confirmation by comparing raw wire values. This is good — the knowledge was captured after this fix.
